content:
Prior to the Great War, Radiant Hills was a nuclear Missile Silo operated by the Strategic Air Command under the USAF. Stationed in the silo complex was a general who was allowed to house his young daughter, Parthenia Blankenship, in the facility with him due to her numerous ailments and lack of a mother. At the facility, scientists had been conducting experiments and developing chemicals with varying effects, such as regeneration, in labs.[1][2] On the day of the Great War a disaster occurred that prevented the silo's Nuclear Missile from firing, and required the complete evacuation of the facility, with the soldiers leaving Parthenia behind.[1]

Parthenia spent the next several years alone in the facility, teaching herself using the military documents and equipment. She went on to discover the experimental chemicals, including the one which induced regeneration in humans. Using what she had learned, she modified the formula into one that would induce ghoulification, using it on herself.[2] Now a Ghoul, she would find herself joined by a group of fellow Ghouls known as The Revenants, Raider survivors from the Ghoul community that had once lived in Valley Galleria.[3] The Revenants fortified the facility with the help of Regular Debbie, a Ghoul from The Pitt they had recruited on the road, transforming it officially into the community of Radiant Hills.[4] A memorial to a member of the group, Elmira, was built atop the silo hatch as she had died during a raid before the Revenants had arrived.[5] Following nearly a decade in the compound, a resident named Eugenie would depart, becoming a merchant and client of the Blue Ridge Caravan Company.[6]

Located in the northern mountains of the Savage Divide, the location consists of both an exterior and interior. The exterior is always accessible, though it contains localized pockets of strong radiation of up to 125 Rads that can prove deadly to Humans without Radiation Resistance, but give Ghouls a quick and easy way to fill their Glow bar. It is also protected by Turrets placed along the edges of the location.

The interior only becomes accessible after becoming a Ghoul, and is first accessed via the Hillside Cavern. Later it can also be accessed via an elevator that connects to and from the surface above Radiant Hills, but only by Ghoul players.

The exterior spreads west to east over two large cliffs, with the northern cliff being slightly elevated. The main entrance is located on its western side. After passing through the gate, the path splits into three directions:

the left path leads up to the northern cliff and onto the wooden structure overlooking the gate at the main entrance.

the middle path leads to the building with the elevator and beyond.

the right path leads to a large double building with a garden and maintenance area behind it.

Left Path

This leads upward to a Patio Table and a small pool of toxic water with a River Tube in it. To the west is the wooden structure overlooking the entrance, which has several Ammo Boxes scattered across it, as well as an Armor Workbench. To the northeast, a set of metal and concrete stairs leads further up, past a ruined building, and to a missile silo shaft, upon which a shrine made of stone is built. East of the shrine is a shooting range with two Ammo Boxes and some weapons. North of the shrine is a small wooden shack that contains a Radio and a Flute. The stairs here lead up to a makeshift shack that contains a Bed.

Middle Path

Going straight ahead, it leads to an open-air cooking area that has a Cooking Station. To the southwest is an elongated building that has two rooms, which contain a variety of junk items in containers. Continuing eastward from the cooking area, a large destroyed building can be seen, which houses the elevator that leads down to the interior. From here, further east is another building that has several Ammo Boxes, and finally a lookout tower that has a Weapons Workbench.

Right Path

This leads to a wooden stair on the right hand side, which grants access to the wooden structure overlooking the entrance. The path leads further down to the area behind the elongated building, which contains both a maintenance area and a garden. The maintenance area has a Power Armor Station and another Weapons Workbench. The garden area has a Graveyard Shovel (which cannot be picked up) and a number of regular and irradiated plants (all of which cannot be harvested). Going past the garden, the path leads back to the middle one, near the building with the elevator.

Exit to the surface above Radiant Hills via elevator on the southern side.

Med Bay in the center.

Living Quarters to the north

Commons area to the west.

Exit to Hillside Cavern, through a doorway on the western wall of the Commons area.

The Commons area has a bar, a beauty and spa salon operated by Jaye Vo, a kitchen with a Cooking Station and a large eating area, and a Tinker's Workbench on the eastern wall. The center has a small one-person stage with a playable Acoustic Guitar.

The Living Quarters, also labeled as "Bunks" or "Power House" have several usable Beds and Sleeping Bags, a Chemistry Station in the northeastern corner, as well as some inactive nuclear generators in the center of the room.

↑ 1.01.1Parthenia Blankenship: "My father was a general, stationed on-site here at the silo. I was an adolescent bag of ailments. My health conditions kept me largely isolated and immobilized, and he was the only family I had. So I had an exception to stay here with him. Well, one day the War happened, and everything went terribly, terribly wrong. There was a very loud noise, lots of distant panic in other rooms, and then... Well, I noticed it was very quiet. When I finally left my room, the place was empty. I guess everyone evacuated, or... Well, I don't know." (Parthenia Blankenship's dialogue)

↑ 2.02.1Parthenia Blankenship: "I was alone like I had always been. Taking care of myself. Reading. Learning. And now, all of their military resources were at my disposal. Books, research documents, laboratory equipment. A whole new playground for knowledge! Most intriguingly, I found an assortment of chemicals ripe for experimentation. I soon found that one of these chemicals had fascinating effects on the human body... Regenerative effects. My analysis and experimentation with this chemical led to the highly functioning flesh chassis you see before you today. I ailed no longer. I was reborn! Fantastic, isn't it?" (Parthenia Blankenship's dialogue)

↑Vault Dweller (Fallout 76): " How did this sanctuary for ghouls come to be? " Maddox Mullen: "It's not the happiest story, but it's a part of who we are. I'll start at the beginning. Valley Galleria, right here in Appalachia. A group of ghouls lived there openly. Others didn't like that so much. A hunter named Duncan McKann was planning to wipe us out. Lucy, who led the survivors there, decided to move everyone out before the attack. Duncan tracked them, of course. If you go to Dyer Chemical, well... you'll see what happened. Me, Asher, and Elmira had broken off from the group. Instead of fleeing north to Dyer, we went east. Covered our tracks well. The idea was to find a place we could start fresh, establish a new identity. One that people wouldn't mess with. You've heard about how we do things." (Maddox's dialogue)

↑Vault Dweller: "How did you leave the Pitt and end up here? " Regular Debbie: "I stayed a long time in Pittsburgh. Clingin' onto home, or at least... the idea of it. But truth was that Pittsburgh became The Pitt. It wasn't home no more, much as I tried to believe it was. Home was gone. Once I finally came to terms with that, it was time to leave. Don't know where to, even now. I was on the road in God knows where when this gang of ghouls visited me in the night. I was shocked to see so many ghouls outside The Pitt. Less shocked when they started explaining things. How they were hunted, then hunted again. Said they was going somewhere to set up permanently, and they needed all the help they could get. Didn't seem like too bad a gig: helping out in exchange for food and shelter. Maddox is under some kind of spell thinking I'm going to join up permanently. This kind of life ain't for me. I'll happily risk my hide in exchange for freedom." (Regular Debbie's dialogue)

↑Maddox Mullen: "We were lucky to find this place. Unfortunately, not all of us made it here. We needed to save up enough resources to make our escape from the area, so we planned one final raid. It was supposed to stay quiet - in and out before anyone knew we were there. But at the time, we weren't used to working that way. The camp got alerted. Elmira... decided to cause a distraction. She tore off her mask and ran in front of the spotlights. They thought she was feral. Bought us enough time to get out while they scanned the entrance for more of "her kind". All we can do now is try to honor her sacrifice. Live on the way she would have wanted us to." (Maddox's dialogue)

↑Eugenie: "You know, I've been doing this traveling merchant thing for a while now. I spent damn near a decade stuck in our compound, hiding from people that would kill us on sight just for being who we are. I've found that rolling into town with supplies and caps to trade eases up the tension, get's people talkin' to you again. The fact that I'm strapped to the teeth in fire power doesn't hurt neither. But some people, like the Blood Eagles... there's no discussion to be had. " (Eugenie's dialogue)
